style: Flat 2D storybook illustration with bold simplified shapes, clean edges, soft cel shading and subtle paper grain. Warm palette of ochre, terracotta and sand with deep teal shadows and strong warm rim light. Setting: a Sumerian town around 3100 BC built of plain sun-dried mudbrick with flat roofs, reed mats and clay pots. Vertical composition with the main subject in the upper two thirds. No text, no letters, no watermark, no border.

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up of a man's fingers rolling a small plain stone cylinder, the size of a thumb, across a palm-sized slab of wet tan clay. Behind the cylinder a shallow embossed band of tiny animal figures appears pressed into the clay, in the same clay colour. Low side light makes the relief cast small shadows. Only the fingers, the stone and the clay are in the frame, dark background.

An empty, quiet stretch of dark teal river at dusk seen from above, framed only by tall reeds. In the centre a small thumb-sized stone cylinder is sinking below the surface, half under water, with a ring of ripples and a few bubbles around it. Only water, reeds and the small stone fill the frame.

Wide view at sunrise: a whitewashed mudbrick temple on a high mudbrick terrace above flat-roofed mudbrick houses, date palms and a canal. In the foreground a line of bare-chested workers with shaved heads and knee-length wrapped wool skirts carries heavy reed baskets of golden barley on their shoulders toward a storehouse. Long shadows, glowing sky.

Inside a mudbrick storehouse, a worried administrator with a shaved head, bare chest and a knee-length wrapped wool skirt stands barefoot between towering heaps of golden barley and rows of big clay pots, both hands on his head, overwhelmed. A shaft of sunlight falls from a small square opening high in the wall, dust in the air. Medium shot.

Close-up over the shoulder of a scribe with a shaved head: his hand holds a thin cut reed stalk like a pen and draws a simple picture of a barley stalk into a small pillow-shaped slab of soft wet clay held in his other palm. Warm oil-lamp light, dark background.

A queue of tired bare-chested workers with shaved heads and knee-length wrapped wool skirts hold out plain clay bowls while an official pours golden barley grain from a clay pot into the first bowl. A scribe sits cross-legged beside him holding a small blank clay tablet. Courtyard with plain mudbrick walls, late afternoon light. Medium wide shot.

A scribe with a shaved head, bare chest and a knee-length wrapped wool skirt sits cross-legged, scratching his head and frowning at a small clay tablet in his hand that shows only a single drawing of a barley stalk. Around him stand many identical clay pots. Slightly comic, puzzled expression. Medium close shot.

Macro close-up filling the whole frame with soft wet tan clay. One hand holds a single thin cut reed stalk upright like a pen and presses its round end straight down into the clay, making a neat row of deep circular holes: three finished holes and a fourth being pressed. Hard grazing light from the left, deep shadows inside each hole. Only the fingertips, one reed and the clay are visible.

Two bare-chested men with shaved heads and knee-length wrapped wool skirts face each other in a mudbrick doorway, in profile. The man on the left holds up a small clay tablet; the man on the right narrows his eyes and points at it with suspicion. Between them a strong shaft of light. Dramatic stand-off, medium shot.

Close-up of a bearded official's bare chest and hands: a small plain stone cylinder the size of a thumb hangs on a cord around his neck and he lifts it with two fingers, proud and deliberate. Warm rim light on the stone, plain dark teal background.

Top-down close-up of one hand pressing and rolling a short thumb-sized stone cylinder along the surface of a palm-sized slab of wet tan clay lying on a woven reed mat. On the clay surface behind the cylinder is a shallow embossed band, in the same clay colour, of tiny figures: a man, two dogs and two boars. Strong raking light from the left makes the embossed figures cast small shadows.

A hunting scene in a reed marsh: a bare-chested man with a shaved head and a plain knee-length wrapped wool skirt strides forward, his two hands holding only two rope leashes with two lean hunting dogs straining ahead, chasing two bristling wild boars that crash through tall reeds and shallow water. Side view like a frieze, everything moving left to right, golden backlight, splashes.

A dim mudbrick room with wooden shelves and reed baskets filled with hundreds of small blank clay tablets. A scribe with a shaved head and a knee-length wrapped wool skirt places one more tablet on a shelf. A single small clay oil lamp lights his face and the nearest tablets, deep teal darkness beyond. Medium wide shot.

Close-up of a single open empty hand, palm up, filling the middle of the frame, lit from above by a narrow warm beam of light. A few glowing dust motes drift just above the empty palm. Plain deep teal background with nothing else in it. Quiet, still.

Close-up of a palm-sized pillow-shaped clay tablet resting in two cupped hands. Across its surface runs a shallow embossed band, in the same clay colour, of tiny figures: a man, dogs and boars. Warm glowing light on the clay, plain dark background, reverent mood. Only the hands and the tablet are in the frame.
